series.en: Google Cloud Agentic Future: English for the Operating Layer
series.zh: Google Cloud Agentic Future：面向 AI 运行层的专业英语人格

title.en: Agents are a new user persona.
title.zh: 把 agents 当作新的用户角色。

subtitle.en: Learn to explain why agentic data platforms need context, permissions, retrieval, and action, not just more data.
subtitle.zh: 学习解释为什么 agentic data platform 需要上下文、权限、检索和行动，而不只是更多数据。

audience: Data leader · AI architect · Product-facing engineer

source.title: Google reimagines data for an agentic data platform
source.speaker: Yasmeen Ahmad

note.en: This lesson is inspired by public interview coverage and Google Cloud's Agentic Data Cloud framing.
note.zh: 本课灵感来自公开采访报道和 Google Cloud Agentic Data Cloud 叙事。

scenario.customer: A data team says their warehouse already has all the enterprise data, so they are not sure why agentic AI changes the platform requirements.
scenario.weakResponse: Agents need access to the data warehouse so they can answer questions and perform actions.
scenario.reliableResponse: The requirement changes because agents are a new user persona. They need more than access to tables; they need trusted context, scoped permissions, retrieval across formats, and a way to turn insight into governed action.

principle.en: Agentic data strategy starts by asking who, or what, the platform is serving.
principle.zh: Agentic data strategy 要先问：平台服务的是谁，或者是什么。

flow.en: Start with the old data persona: analysts, engineers, and applications.
flow.zh: 先讲旧的数据角色：分析师、工程师和应用。

flow.en: Introduce the new persona: agents that retrieve, reason, act, and hand off.
flow.zh: 引入新角色：会检索、推理、行动和交接的 agents。

flow.en: Show why raw data is not enough without business context.
flow.zh: 说明为什么没有业务上下文，原始数据不够。

flow.en: Connect context to trust: permissions, lineage, meaning, and policy.
flow.zh: 把上下文连接到信任：权限、血缘、含义和政策。

flow.en: Close with the human role: people move from manual analysis to orchestration and judgment.
flow.zh: 以人的角色收尾：人从手动分析转向协调和判断。

phraseBank.line: The design requirement changes when the user is no longer only a human analyst, but also an agent.

why.en: It gives the architecture argument a simple starting point.
why.zh: 给架构论证一个简单起点。

intent.zh: 解释为什么上下文重要。

phraseBank.line: The missing layer is not more data; it is trusted business context.

why.en: It is concise, memorable, and strategic.

phraseBank.line: Humans move from being the doer to being the orchestrator.

why.en: It turns automation into a leadership story.
why.zh: 把自动化讲成领导力故事。

meaning.en: A type of user the product or platform is designed to serve.
meaning.zh: 产品或平台设计时服务的一类用户。

use.en: Treating agents as a user persona changes platform requirements.
use.zh: 把 agents 当成 user persona 会改变平台需求。

meaning.en: The meanings, rules, relationships, and constraints that make data usable in a business.
meaning.zh: 让数据在业务中可用的含义、规则、关系和限制。

use.en: Business context tells the agent what the data means and how it may be used.
use.zh: Business context 告诉 agent 数据是什么意思、可以如何使用。

meaning.en: The record of where data came from and how it changed.
meaning.zh: 数据来自哪里以及如何变化的记录。

use.en: Lineage matters when an agent's answer needs to be trusted.
use.zh: 当 agent 的答案需要被信任时，lineage 很重要。

meaning.en: A system that not only stores or analyzes data, but helps trigger governed work.
meaning.zh: 不只是存储或分析数据，而是帮助触发受治理行动的系统。

use.en: Agentic data turns a system of record into a system of action.
use.zh: Agentic data 把记录系统变成行动系统。

intent.zh: 把用户角色连接到需求。

logicMoves.line: If the user is an agent, the platform has to expose meaning, permissions, and context, not just data.

why.en: It explains the design change through a clean cause-and-effect.
why.zh: 用清晰因果解释设计变化。

logicMoves.line: More data does not automatically create better agent behavior; better context does.

why.en: It challenges a common but weak assumption.
why.zh: 挑战常见但薄弱的假设。

logicMoves.line: The human role becomes less about retrieving every answer and more about supervising the system of action.

why.en: It makes automation feel like role evolution, not replacement.
why.zh: 让自动化听起来像角色进化，而不是替代。

conversationLessons.en: A strong architecture explanation often begins by redefining the user.
conversationLessons.zh: 强架构解释常常从重新定义用户开始。

conversationLessons.en: Context is a leadership word when it explains why raw capability is not enough.
conversationLessons.zh: 当 context 解释为什么原始能力不够时，它就是领导力词汇。

conversationLessons.en: The best data-platform language connects data, meaning, permission, and action.
conversationLessons.zh: 最好的数据平台表达会连接数据、含义、权限和行动。

anchor.phrase: agents are a new user persona
anchor.quote: Agents are a new user persona, so the platform has to serve a different kind of work.

concept.en: When a new user appears, requirements change. This is a clean way to make future architecture feel logical.
concept.zh: 当新用户出现，需求就改变。这个表达能让未来架构显得有逻辑。

intent.en: Explain why data access is not enough.
intent.zh: 解释为什么数据访问不够。

examples.line: Access lets the agent see the data; context tells it what the data means.

why.en: It creates a sharp distinction between access and meaning.
why.zh: 清楚区分 access 和 meaning。

examples.line: An agent should not inherit unlimited authority just because it can retrieve useful information.
The person becomes more valuable when they can orchestrate the system instead of manually chasing every answer.

why.en: It makes the career implication positive and concrete.
why.zh: 把职业含义讲得积极且具体。

lines.line: The platform was originally built for human users; agentic AI adds a new user with different needs.

why.en: It makes the shift understandable without jargon.
why.zh: 不用术语也能让变化变清楚。

lines.line: Trusted context means the agent can understand what the data represents, where it came from, and what it is allowed to do with it.

why.en: It gives context a practical definition.
why.zh: 给 context 一个实用定义。

intent.zh: 解释为什么这有战略意义。

lines.line: The data platform becomes strategic when it can support both human judgment and agentic action.

why.en: It connects data strategy to enterprise AI.
why.zh: 连接数据战略和企业 AI。

lines.line: The bottleneck is not always data availability; sometimes it is whether the system understands the business meaning of the data.
The professional who understands this shift can speak to data, AI, governance, and workflow in the same conversation.

why.en: It links the architecture lesson to learner identity.
why.zh: 把架构课连接到学习者身份。

prompt.en: Practice explaining agents as a new user persona.
prompt.zh: 练习把 agents 解释为新的用户角色。

steps.en: A data leader says the warehouse already has all the data.
steps.zh: 数据负责人说仓库已经有所有数据。

focus.en: Explain the gap between data and trusted context.
focus.zh: 解释数据和可信上下文的差距。

steps.en: A team wants agents to query everything.
steps.zh: 团队想让 agents 查询所有东西。

steps.en: A learner asks how this changes their career.
steps.zh: 学习者问这如何改变职业。

focus.en: Describe the move from doer to orchestrator.
focus.zh: 描述从 doer 到 orchestrator 的转变。
